Paying, and stopping if you want to

How to pay?

  • When you order: 25% of the website, so €125 for a €500 website, plus the options you chose.
  • When you receive the website: the rest in one go (€375), or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments, for example €31.25 a month for 12 months. Your plan starts that day.
  • Your plan: Peace of Mind €10 a month or Growth €20 a month. Yearly, 2 months free.

And if you stop?

  • You stop whenever you like: a message is enough, or the button in your client area. Your plan ends at the end of the period already paid.
  • Your domain name stays yours: it is in your name, and you can transfer it wherever you like.
  • You leave with your website: I give you its files, texts, images and pages, so it can be hosted elsewhere. Our hosting stops 30 days after your plan ends.
  • The only exception: if you pay the rest of the website in 6 or 12 instalments, you commit for the length of that payment. If you leave early, what remains of the website price is due in one go.
And compared with other solutions?Agency, freelancer, platform: the comparison, line by line. Refer a friend, and earn a monthOne free month on your plan, for you and for the person you refer.

Your questions about prices

How much does it cost, all in?

€500 once for the website. If I take care of everything, add €10 or €20 a month depending on the plan you choose. With Peace of Mind, the first year comes to €620, or €600 if you pay for the plan yearly. With website only, you pay just for the website. The online shop and the SEO Pack, if you take them, are paid only once.

Which plan should I choose?

Take Peace of Mind, at €10 a month, if you want a website that is looked after and kept up to date without you thinking about it. Choose Growth, at €20 a month, if you want your website to grow: your requests go first, and a new page for Google is added every week. Neither has any commitment, and you can switch along the way.

What does the Peace of Mind plan include?

Everything that keeps your website online and up to date. It includes hosting (the place where your website stays available day and night), the domain name (its address), backups (safety copies), security, monitoring and maintenance, meaning the regular technical checks that keep the website in working order. Your changes are included, with no limit, and live within 72 hours at most.

And the Growth plan?

It includes everything in Peace of Mind. On top of that, your change requests are handled first, with an average turnaround of 12 to 24 hours instead of 72 hours at most. Every week, an SEO page is also added to your website: one more page to be found on Google.

Are changes limited?

No. With both plans, you ask for as many changes as you like. Adding text or photos, changing opening hours, adding a page as long as the website stays within its 20 pages: all of that counts as a change. Only a complete redesign or a new feature, such as appointment booking, is quoted separately.

Are the domain name and hosting included?

Yes, if you let me handle putting it online. The domain name is your website’s address, like your-name.fr: you choose it when you order, and I register it in your name. Hosting is the place where your website is kept so it stays visible 24 hours a day. Both are free for the first year, unless you take the online shop, then your plan covers them, at no extra cost. With website only, you keep your own.

I already have my domain name and my hosting. What should I do?

Choose “I will handle it myself” when you order: that is the website only option. You only pay for your website, €500, with no monthly plan: 25% when you order, then the rest on delivery, in one go or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments. Once the website is finished, I give you its code: all its files and a full backup, with a short guide to install it. You install it yourself or with help from your hosting provider, who often has free guides for this. After that, maintenance, security and changes are not included, but you can take a plan later.

Monthly or yearly?

As you prefer. Yearly, you pay for 10 months and 2 are free: €100 for Peace of Mind, €200 for Growth. You can switch from one to the other at renewal.

How do I get the event offer?

If we meet at a fair, a market, a trade show or a business event, you get an event code. Type it in when you order: it takes 20% off your website, and off the online shop if you take it. The monthly plan prices do not change.

And for an online shop?

It is a €200 option, paid once, so €700 with the website. You get a catalogue of your products, a basket, online payment, order management and emails sent automatically to your customers. Champi, the seller in my little band, takes care of it with you. Your monthly plan stays the same.

Why is it 4 to 5 times cheaper than a website made by hand?

Because I spent a lot of time programming my little band: automations that do everything that repeats. With a freelancer, a 10-page showcase website with SEO often costs between €2,000 and €3,000, and an agency charges even more. With me, it is €500, and your website is still designed, checked and tested by me. No magic, just organisation.

Are there any hidden costs?

No. The order summary shows everything: the website, the shop if you add it, and your plan if you choose one. A quote only comes up for a big job, such as rebuilding the whole website, and you accept it or not before I start.

Happy with the price?

Build your website in two minutes: the total is shown before you order.
